message: As a parent, it's easy to get caught up in the daily chaos and forget about the little things that can keep our families safe. I recently stumbled upon some great tips for fire preparedness that really got me thinking about how to talk to my kids about this in a calm, friendly way. 😊 It's all about making sure they know what to do in case of an emergency—without turning it into a scary conversation. A little prep now can go a long way! How do you share safety tips with your kids?
